_comment: Card D3's replay task pool: tasks of card D1's fixture sessions (fixtures/sessions/d1/index.json), each with an invented starting repository, so card D2's candidates can be replayed on tasks they were not induced from. synthetic/bump-timeout-06 is one of the ten tasks D2 induced from: the split drops it, and the script has no session for it. Its starting repository differs from that of the held-out synthetic/bump-timeout-16, which shares its prompt: a held-out task with an induction task's prompt and start state is refused (card D3 review, D3-8). Each check is the task's own, a repository-state hash in the manner of tau2-bench's database check: the session's final files against the files the gold edits produce from the same start. Synthetic content, no real person or repository.
